name: Gasthof Felsenstuberl
beschreibung:
Perched on a sunny slope in Soelden, Gasthof Felsenstueberl is a favoured spot for skiers and mountain walkers. Comfortably furnished rooms and a scenic sun terrace invite guests to relax.

The base terminals for the Gaislachkogl and Giggijoch cable cars are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Felsenstueberl in Soelden provides cosy rooms and hearty home-style cooking in Oetztal.
